title: A slot binding needs exactly one operator
accepts: a binding with exactly one of gate, chain or fan-out
refuses: a binding with no operator

title: A maturity stage is exactly alpha, beta or ga
accepts: alpha, beta and ga.
refuses: Alpha, GA, rc, stable, the empty string, and ' ga' with a space: each is refused with an error that names the value and the three stages.

title: A registry trust is common or local, and no other value
accepts: common and local, each as the trust of a registry source.
refuses: Common, global, trusted and the empty string: each is refused, and the refusal names the value and the two values it may be.

title: A content digest is exactly 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits
accepts: The SHA-256 digest of the empty input, e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855, and a digest of 64 zeros.
refuses: The same digest with 63 digits, with 65 digits, with upper-case digits, with the prefix sha256:, and with one digit g: each is refused.

title: A source state is exactly unknown, clean or modified
accepts: A build identity with source state unknown, VCS unknown and revision unknown; one with source state clean, VCS git and a full revision; and one with source state modified, VCS git and a full revision: saving the record succeeds for each.
refuses: Source state trusted, Clean and the empty string, each with VCS git and a full revision: each is refused, and saving the record fails.
notes: Proved by the subtest ST-VO42-C01-T of TestCompilerBuildState: it saves each of unknown (with VCS and revision unknown), clean and modified, and refuses trusted, Clean and the empty string.

title: When the VCS or the revision is unknown, the VCS, the revision and the source state are all unknown
accepts: A build identity with VCS, revision and source state all unknown; and one with VCS git, a full revision and source state clean.
refuses: A build identity with VCS unknown and a full revision; with VCS git and revision unknown; and with VCS and revision unknown and source state clean: each is refused, and saving the record fails.

title: A revision that is not a full commit ID is refused before any download
accepts: 40 lower-case hexadecimal digits
refuses: main: installation fails and makes no API call

title: A fill signature is an armored detached SSH or GPG signature of its own key type
accepts: Key type ssh with a whole armored block from the line -----BEGIN SSH SIGNATURE----- to the line -----END SSH SIGNATURE-----, as ssh-keygen -Y sign writes it; key type gpg with a whole armored block from -----BEGIN PGP SIGNATURE----- to -----END PGP SIGNATURE-----, as gpg --detach-sign --armor writes it.
refuses: Each of these is refused, and the fault names the field: key type SSH in capitals, x509, and an empty key type; key type ssh with a PGP signature block; key type gpg with an SSH signature block; an SSH signature in binary form; an SSH signature block with its BEGIN line and no END line; and a clear-signed PGP message that starts with -----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE-----.
notes: Not automated yet: fill.Signature is not written. The case with no END line catches a check of the first line alone.

title: A qualification standing is exactly one of qualified, stale, unsigned or untested
accepts: qualified, stale, unsigned and untested.
refuses: Qualified in capitals, qualified with a space after it, signed, expired and an empty value: each is refused.
notes: Not automated yet: fill.Standing is not written.

title: A slot reference is a component name, a period and a slot name, each not empty
accepts: rest-api.before_create and event-publisher.on_entity_changed.
refuses: before_create, .before_create, rest-api., a period alone and an empty value: each is refused, and the fault names the reference.
notes: Not automated yet: types.SlotRef is not written.

title: A quality evidence kind is one of the five kinds of the bar, and no other value
accepts: security-review, benchmark, design-review, reference-comparison and conformance, each as the kind of one piece of evidence, as stego registry evidence --kind writes them.
refuses: review, Benchmark, performance, conformance-pass and the empty string: each is refused, and the refusal names the value and the five kinds it may be.
notes: The spelling of each kind is the one in the usage of stego registry evidence (ST-SUP-CLI17), where port conformance is written conformance.

title: The SDK inventory digest follows the contents and refuses links
accepts: An SDK folder of plain files, whose digest changes when a file's mode changes.
refuses: A folder with a symlink, or more files or bytes than the limits allow.
notes: Not proof yet: nothing ties the digest to an official Go release.

title: A changed or unsafe SDK archive is refused before parsing and leaves no folder
accepts: The pinned archive with the pinned size and digest, whose inventory equals the pinned inventory.
refuses: An archive of another size or digest, one holding a link, a device, a sparse file, a repeated path or a traversal, and one whose inventory differs; each is refused before parsing or leaves no folder.
notes: Ten tests in scripts/test_compiler_toolchain.py cover this once a subtest carries this ID.

title: An SBOM format is exactly SPDX or CycloneDX in its standard form
accepts: SPDX, written as an SPDX 2.3 JSON document, and CycloneDX, written as a CycloneDX 1.5 JSON document.
refuses: An empty format, spdx in lower case, CycloneDX with a space, SWID and SPDX,CycloneDX: each is refused.

title: A signer identity is a keyless pipeline identity or a key, never both
accepts: An HTTPS OIDC issuer with a workflow subject at an exact reference, such as @refs/heads/main; or the SHA-256 digest of a public key.
refuses: Both a keyless identity and a key, neither, an issuer or a subject alone, a subject with no exact reference, an issuer on plain HTTP, and a key that is not a digest: each is refused.

title: A CI provider is exactly github-actions or konflux
accepts: github-actions and konflux.
refuses: GitHub-Actions, gitlab, tekton, the empty string, and 'konflux ' with a space: each is refused with an error that names the two providers.

title: A pipeline reference is accepted only by a full commit hash or a sha256 digest
accepts: A location with a pin of 40 lower-case hexadecimal characters, such as example/platform/.github/workflows/stego.yml at 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567, and a bundle repository with a pin of sha256: and 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters.
refuses: Each of these pins, each refused with a reason that names the pin: the tag v1.2.0, the branch main, refs/heads/main, the short hash 0123456, a hash of 39 and of 41 characters, a hash with a character that is not hexadecimal, sha256: with 63 characters, a sha512: digest, and an empty pin.
notes: The value type ST-VO52-VT parses the reference. The same values prove the predicate of ST-DLV-SP02; this test proves that the value type refuses them, so that no record can hold an unpinned reference.

title: A requirement kind is accepted only when it is one of the nine known kinds
accepts: Each of secret, configuration, backing store, topic, identity issuer, ingress, egress, cluster permission and pod security.
refuses: Each of an empty kind, database, Secret in another letter case, secret with a space after it, and volume, each refused with a reason that names the kind.
notes: The field meaning of ST-VO53 says database where the constraint says backing store. This test follows the constraint, as ST-DLV-UC01-R01 does; the field meaning is the one to correct.

title: A test result is exactly passed, failed or skipped, and only passed counts as a pass
accepts: passed, failed and skipped, each read as itself.
refuses: No text, pass, ok, error, Passed, PASSED, and text with a space or a newline: ParseResult returns an error. Failed, skipped and any other text do not count as a pass.

title: Each count is between zero and the total, a share is the count over the total, and an empty spec is 100%
accepts: Counts from zero to the total, such as 4, 2 and 0 of 4, 412, 301 and 96 of 412, and an empty spec of 0 of 0. Each share is its count over the total, an empty spec's shares are 100%, and the coverage reads the same text each time.
refuses: A designed, built or proved count below zero or above the total, and a total below zero: NewCoverage returns an error.

title: An attestation names its subject by a full commit, never a tag, a branch or a short ID
accepts: A full commit ID of 40 lower-case hexadecimal digits.
refuses: A tag, a branch, a branch reference, a short ID, 39 or 41 digits, upper-case digits, a character that is not hexadecimal, and no subject: NewAttestation returns an error.

title: A gate kind is exactly change or release
accepts: change and release, each read as itself.
refuses: No text, Change, RELEASE, text with a space or a newline, merge, change,release and ratchet: ParseGateKind returns an error.

title: A runtime pin names a module path, a tagged version and its checksum, never a branch, a pseudo-version or a replace
accepts: The module path of the runtime library, version v0.4.1, and its go.sum hash h1:<44 base64 characters>=.
refuses: A pin with no checksum; with version main; with a pseudo-version v0.0.0-20260101000000-abcdefabcdef; and with a replace directive to a local folder: each is refused, and the error names the field.

title: A malformed image target list is refused
accepts: One to sixty-four targets with unique names and safe relative paths.
refuses: A repeated name, an unknown or repeated field, an unsafe path, shell syntax, zero targets or sixty-five.
notes: Proved today against .ci/application-images.json by scripts/test_application_matrix.py; under the model the list lives in the delivery stanza of service.yaml.

title: Money is integer minor units with an ISO 4217 code, a float is refused, and only one currency adds
accepts: 1050 EUR, made as integer minor units with the code EUR; and the sum of 1050 EUR and 250 EUR, which is 1300 EUR.
refuses: 10.50 EUR, refused as not integer minor units; 1050 with the code EURO, refused as not an ISO 4217 code; the sum of 1050 EUR and 250 USD, refused as two currencies; and the minimum balance 10.5 of customer_wallet in ST-DECL-TD04, refused by checking with a fault that names the field.
notes: Not automated yet: the Money value type (ST-VO61-VT) is not built.
